Name: Godly Voice - A Diary of Friends (AI Social Mod)
Author: Aerishiph
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#f2c14e]GODLY VOICE[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][color=#9ccc65]A Diary of Friends[/color][/size]
[size=2][i]AI Social Mod · Part of the Godly Series[/i][/size]
“No children were harmed in the making of this mod. Several were emotionally wounded. Vincent is fine. Mostly.”
[b]Talk to villagers in your own words.
They remember. They have bad days. They talk about you.[/b][/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]💬 TALK[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Real conversations[/b] with anyone you've met.[/*]
[*][b]Type your reply[/b], or tap one of the drafted options.[/*]
[*][b]Controller friendly[/b] with the on-screen keyboard. (Honestly, it's slow. That's what the options are for. I wouldn't want to hunt and peck either.)[/*]
[*]Villagers know the [b]time, weather, where they're headed[/b], upcoming festivals, and what you gave them today.[/*]
[*][b]Say the right thing, gain friendship.[/b] Say the wrong thing... you'll find out.[/*]
[/list][size=2][i]First meetings, gifts, quests, festivals and events stay vanilla. If the AI fails or times out, you just get the normal line.[/i][/size]

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]📖 THE DIARY[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Day one: [b]Mom mails a care package[/b] with a nightstand and your diary.[/*]
[*]Set it by your bed. [b]Click the nightstand to read before you sleep.[/b] 40 styles to choose from. It's a set place for your book.[/*]
[*]Every villager gets [b]their own chapter[/b]: profile, hearts, favorites, and every conversation you've had.[/*]
[*]Memories fade after two weeks. [b]Press ♥[/b] to keep one forever, up to [b]10 per villager[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Heart events are remembered for good[/b], choices included. Modded events too.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🌦 MOODS[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Every morning, everyone wakes up a little different.

[b][color=#e57373]Furious[/color][/b] · [b][color=#ffb74d]Grumpy[/color][/b] · [b][color=#90a4ae]Sleepy[/color][/b] · [b][color=#81c784]Sick[/color][/b] · [b][color=#64b5f6]Lonely[/color][/b] · [b][color=#ba68c8]Wistful[/color][/b] · [b][color=#a1887f]Worried[/color][/b]

Moods stack. Each villager shows them their own way.
Birthdays put them in a good mood. [i]Unless you bring the wrong gift.[/i][/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🗣 WORD GETS AROUND[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Hurt someone and [b]the town might hear[/b]. Family and friends first, then everyone.[/*]
[*]People who heard may [b]call you over to explain yourself[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Apologize[/b], if you dare. It depends on their mood and how soon you try.[/*]
[*]Kids forgive. [b]Their parents don't forget.[/b][/*]
[*]Some things are [b]never forgiven[/b]. (Optional.)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🏡 A LIVING TOWN[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Call-outs:[/b] villagers wave you over as you pass.[/*]
[*][b]Gifts for you:[/b] friends at 4+ hearts bring you things they love.[/*]
[*][b]Overheard chats:[/b] villagers stop to talk, or argue, near you.[/*]
[*][b]Gift reactions:[/b] in their own words. The gift itself works like vanilla.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]⚙ YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b]Almost everything can be changed or turned off.[/b]
AI chance · conversation length · moods and their odds · reputation · grudges · call-outs · overheard chats · friendship gain ([i]Low, Neutral, or Cheaty[/i])[/center]
[list]
[*][b]Step-by-step Setup page[/b]: pick a provider, get a key, choose a model, test it.[/*]
[*][b]One-click recommended settings[/b] for every plan.[/*]
[*][b]Save your own settings profiles.[/b] Your key is never stored in them.[/*]
[*][b]Troubleshoot mode[/b] helps out when you're having problems. If there's an issue, often the troubleshoot will solve it. It all shows in the console of SAMPI.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🔑 AI PROVIDERS[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b][color=#9ccc65]Anthropic (Claude), recommended[/color][/b]: built and tested with it. On Haiku, about [b]20¢ for a full day[/b] of talking and troubleshooting.[/*]
[*][b]Gemini[/b]: free, with a daily limit. [i]Heads up: most of this mod's features can't run well on Gemini's free limits.[/i][/*]
[*][b]OpenRouter[/b]: free models with a limit, or paid.[/*]
[*][b]OpenAI[/b]: pay as you go.[/*]
[*][b]Your own PC[/b] (Ollama / LM Studio): free and private. Needs a decent GPU, and replies are slower.[/*]
[/list][quote][b]Free plans have daily limits.[/b] Picking one turns most extras off automatically so you don't run out, and the mod stops just before your limit. Villagers use their normal lines until tomorrow.
[b][color=#9ccc65]For the full experience, go paid. It's cheap.[/color][/b] I put in $5, chatted literally all day while testing (and played ValleyTalk too), and I've still got $4.80 left.[/quote][size=2]Type [b]gv_cost[/b] in the SMAPI console to see your spending, or track your limits in GMCM. Your key never shows up in logs.[/size]

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🧩 CUSTOM NPCs[/color][/b][/size][/center]
Every vanilla villager comes with a bio. Custom NPCs need one too:
[list]
[*][b]NPC Bio Maker[/b] (HTML, in Optional Files) walks you through it.[/*]
[*]Bios can hide [b]secrets[/b] that only come out at certain heart levels.[/*]
[*]NPC authors can ship a bio [b]inside their own mod[/b]. Players without Godly Voice just ignore it.[/*]
[/list][quote][b]I won't make bios for other people's NPCs.[/b] Even with permission, those characters belong to their creators, and they know them best. I just don't think I could do them justice. If you want your NPC in, the tools are there, and I'm happy to help you understand the mod and how to use it for your characters.[/quote]
[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (strongly recommended: the setup page lives there)[/*]
[*]An AI provider[/*]
[/list][b]Multiplayer:[/b] mostly tested in single player. Some features (like overheard chats) only run on the host. More testing is coming. And if it doesn't work yet? That's okay. I'm spiteful, and I [i]will[/i] make it work. I'm rather threatening to code. 

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]🔧 HOW THIS WAS MADE[/color][/b][/size][/center]
One person. No team. I work in [b]automation maintenance[/b] (PLC programming), and I'm learning [b]C# from scratch[/b] with this mod. Same way I learned Stardew NPC modding: through frustration and an inability to give up.

[b]AI helped a lot[/b] with writing the code and teaching me C# along the way. [b]The ideas, the systems, and the rules they follow are mine[/b]: the moods, the reputation, the grudges, the diary, how it all falls back to vanilla. AI fills the gaps in what I know. It doesn't design. And every bit of testing was by hand: compiling the DLL, then checking each step in game to make sure it looked right and played well.

[size=2][i](See "rungs," "latches" and "one-shots" in the source comments? That's the PLC brain talking. It's the only coding English I know.)[/i][/size]

[line]

[center][size=4][b][color=#f2c14e]❤ CREDITS[/color][/b][/size]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30319][b]ValleyTalk[/b][/url] by dandm1. Go check it out.
[b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley · [b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI · [b]spacechase0[/b] for GMCM[/center]

[line]

[center][size=2][b]Something broke?[/b] Type [b]gv_faults[/b] or [b]gv_test[/b] in the SMAPI console, and include your SMAPI log in bug reports. Worried about console clutter? Turn off troubleshooting mode.

[b][color=#f2c14e]Have fun![/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
